description: Get a job by its job_id. No account needed. By default the answer has the same compact shape search_jobs returns (rank 1, job_id, job_ad, company_id, locations, work_arrangement, pay, posted_at, first_seen_at, posting_url, apply_url) with the whole description in job_ad.description, currentness, stale and last_checked_at (is it still open, and when was it last checked), and every linked posting in postings (status, last_fetched_at, application_check). Pass view: "full" for every field as the REST API returns it. Use fields to select top-level job properties; job_id is always included.

fields.description: Top-level job properties as a comma-separated string or field array; job_id is always included.

view.description: compact (default): the same summary search_jobs returns, plus the whole description, whether the job is still open, when it was last checked, and the linked postings. full: every field of the job, as the REST API returns it.

name: get_job
title: Get job details
